description.value: The Brownstone has been a downtown Kamloops landmark since 2004, housed in the beautifully restored 1904 Canadian Bank of Commerce building — once the workplace of poet Robert Service. The kitchen leans heavily on local BC producers, with rustic breads, charcuterie, and cheeses made in-house and herbs grown in the restaurant's own garden courtyard. Featured on Food Network Canada's Big Food Bucket List, it offers touring cyclists an upscale but welcoming dinner destination in the heart of Kamloops.
